svg.title: CSF: Cerebrospinal fluid assays
svg.desc: CSF (Cerebrospinal fluid assays), acquisition cost 1.5 units. Fluid from around the brain and spinal cord, drawn by lumbar puncture and assayed. Incremental AUC over the cheap-only model at 12, 24 and 36 months: +0.012, +0.024, +0.056.
